title: Bootstrap prompt-first onboarding before invoking an unbuilt runtime
summary: Separate source-only bootstrap, identity, confidentiality scope, and first-work readiness.
reusable_steps: Separate source-only bootstrap, identity, confidentiality scope, and first-work readiness
expected_outcome: Make LLM CLI setup instructions readable before dependencies and dist exist. Bootstrap in canonical first-win order without bypassing runnable failure or circuit-breaker behavior. Gather actual identity in conversation, then dry-run and apply the same JSON. Personal use needs no tenant; company setup explicitly binds its tenant. Separate service connections from organization services. Reuse saved receipts when resuming and retain human activation and provider-egress approval. Validate facade behavior separately from fresh-clone end-to-end claims.
